quest.title: The Top Dog of the Criminal Underworld
quest.description: Jahoda warns you that the individual staying at The Flagship is a top dog of the criminal underworld. You'd do well to stay on their good side...
quest.rewards_formatted: Mora x10000, Adventurer's Experience x4, Mystic Enhancement Ore x3

chapter.num: Where Waves Meet the Reef: Part I
chapter.title: A Commission From the Curatorium of Secrets

dialogues.speaker: Paimon
dialogues.text: The Flagship... Guess this participant decided to figure out lodging first.

response.speaker: Navia
response.text: You got that right. Representing the Spina di Rosula, of course.

response.speaker: Paimon
response.text: Top dog of the criminal underworld... Yep, that checks out.

response.speaker: Paimon
response.text: Top dog of the criminal underworld... Yep, that checks out.

response.speaker: Navia
response.text: Haha, is that my new nickname? I'm not opposed — it's kinda snazzy.

response.speaker: Paimon
response.text: It's great that we found you! We're working a commission to help with participant registration right now. Y'know, goods verification, stuff like that...

response.speaker: Navia
response.text: Oh, I see. Well, in that case, take a seat. I ordered a whole bunch of food. Clorinde and Chevreuse went to unpack some things, but should be back in a sec... Ohh, speak of the devil!

response.speaker: Clorinde
response.text: Talking about us?

response.speaker: Paimon
response.text: Clorinde! Chevreuse! You're here too!

response.speaker: Clorinde
response.text: Nod-Krai is a chaotic and dangerous place. Considering the Spina's importance to Fontaine, the last thing we need is for something to happen to its president.

response.speaker: Navia
response.text: I do find it nice to travel with friends, but c'mon... Look who you're talking to! What's the worst that could happen?

response.speaker: Clorinde
response.text: With that nonchalant attitude, it's anybody's guess...

response.speaker: Navia
response.text: Fair enough. Guess you can mark down our Champion Duelist here as my... bodyguard.

response.speaker: Paimon
response.text: Gang boss and her bodyguard... Got it. Should we mark you down for the expo too, Chevreuse?

response.speaker: Chevreuse
response.text: No need. I'm here on official business. A lot of our recent cases have had ties to Nod-Krai.

response.speaker: Paimon
response.text: Aaand that's Paimon's cue to butt out, hehe.

response.speaker: Paimon
response.text: Oh, one more thing! What's the Spina planning to trade at the expo?

response.speaker: Navia
response.text: Ah, this right here! It's one of the Fontaine Research Institute's newest inventions. It's a kind of relay system that allows the user to unleash pneuma and ousia energy in battle!

response.speaker: Paimon
response.text: So, it's... a weapon?

response.speaker: Navia
response.text: Of course! At a market with no legal oversight like this one, weapons are gonna be the first to go!

response.speaker: Paimon
response.text: Guess so... Still, bragging about not having to follow the law in front of Chevreuse feels wrong.

response.speaker: Chevreuse
response.text: I don't mind. I've read quite a bit about "lawless territories" in crime novels before.

response.speaker: Chevreuse
response.text: As a detective, I know that I'll need to put the rules aside for now if I want to get things done here.

response.speaker: Chevreuse
response.text: And, on that note, I should get to work. I've got Patrol members waiting on me.

response.speaker: Paimon
response.text: Well, ready to head over to the venue? Just follow us!

response.speaker: Navia
response.text: Alright, let's get this show on the road! I wanna get a bit of shopping in as well.

talks.objective: Take Navia and Clorinde to the event venue

dialogues.speaker: Black Screen
dialogues.text: You lead Navia and Clorinde to the venue.

dialogues.speaker: Navia
dialogues.text: Wow, it's even bigger than I expected. I'm hoping more people will show up, though...

dialogues.speaker: Paimon
dialogues.text: It'll get busier once things kick off. Still, looks like Jahoda needs a lot of help.

dialogues.speaker: Navia
dialogues.text: Well, Clorinde and I are all set up for now. Be sure to stop by our booth when you get a chance!
